titulo_en: All Quiet on the Western Front

textos.As opiniões divergem sobre a eficácia da: Opinions diverge on the effectiveness of the narrative and its structure. While most of those who do not recommend it criticize the lack of depth and development of the characters, about half of those who recommend it highlight the message about armed conflicts and their rulers.
textos.Fidelidade ao livro e à adaptação de 193: Fidelity to the book and the 1930 adaptation
textos.Este grupo critica o filme por se afasta: This group criticizes the film for departing from the original novel and the 1930 version, omitting important passages and changing the ending, which strips the work of its character.
textos.Várias reviews negativas descrevem a exp: Several negative reviews describe the experience as boring and long, with little emotional involvement and a feeling that the film stretches on unnecessarily.
textos.Personagens rasos e falta de desenvolvim: Shallow characters and lack of development
textos.Os personagens são vistos como figuras s: The characters are seen as figures without depth, hard to tell apart or empathize with, which weakens the emotional impact of the tragedies.
textos.A música é criticada por ser dramática d: The music is criticized as too dramatic, insistent and at times disrespectful, getting in the way of contemplation and sounding artificial.
textos.Espectacularização da violência e estéti: Spectacularization of violence and commercial aesthetics
textos.Algumas reviews apontam que o filme tran: Some reviews point out that the film turns war into visual spectacle, with beautiful cinematography that glamorizes suffering, contradicting its anti-war message.
textos.Mensagem simplista e falta de sutileza: Simplistic message and lack of subtlety
textos.O filme é acusado de expor suas intençõe: The film is accused of exposing its intentions in an obvious, repetitive way, without offering new reflection on war, treating the audience as if it needed basic explanations.
textos.Várias reviews medianas relatam que, ape: Several middling reviews report that, despite the technical quality, they could not get emotionally involved with the soldiers, finding them underdeveloped or generic, which hurt the story's impact.
textos.Algumas pessoas deste grupo consideraram: Some people in this group found the film slow, with long sequences that add nothing, leading to disconnection or boredom, especially in the first half.
textos.Elogio à fotografia e aspectos técnicos: Praise for the cinematography and technical aspects
textos.As reviews medianas frequentemente elogi: Middling reviews often praise the cinematography, the score and the visual recreation of war, describing them as impressive and immersive, even when the narrative is unconvincing.
textos.Este grupo reconhece que o filme retrata: This group acknowledges that the film portrays the horrors of the trenches, the violence and the soldiers' suffering in a raw, realistic way, conveying the brutality of the conflict.
textos.Comparações desfavoráveis com o livro ou: Unfavorable comparisons with the book or earlier versions
textos.Diversas reviews medianas apontam que a: Several middling reviews point out that the adaptation leaves out essential scenes and criticisms from the original novel, such as the protagonist's return to civilian life, and that other versions conveyed the anti-war message better.
textos.Crítica à subtrama política e ao excesso: Criticism of the political subplot and excessive didacticism
textos.Algumas reviews medianas criticam a incl: Some middling reviews criticize the inclusion of the political plot with caricatured generals, which sounds artificial and breaks the pace, and also consider the anti-war message obvious or unsubtle.
textos.As reviews destacam que o filme retrata: Reviews highlight that the film portrays war in a raw, realistic way, showing the suffering, the brutality and the senselessness of the conflict, without romanticizing it.
textos.A fotografia é frequentemente elogiada c: The cinematography is often praised as beautiful and impactful, contributing to immersion in the film's atmosphere, as are the score and the visual effects.
textos.As atuações, especialmente a do protagon: The performances, especially the lead's, are highly praised, with emphasis on the character's transformation over the course of the narrative.
textos.Crítica à guerra e aos líderes: Criticism of war and its leaders
textos.O filme é visto como uma forte crítica à: The film is seen as a strong criticism of war and of those who promote it, contrasting the soldiers' suffering with the leaders' indifference.
textos.Algumas reviews comparam o filme ao livr: Some reviews compare the film to the book, noting that the adaptation is good but leaves out aspects considered important by readers of the original work.
textos.Muitos espectadores relatam que o filme: Many viewers report that the film is emotionally heavy, sad and disturbing, leaving a lasting impression.
textos.busca um retrato cru e realista da guerr: are after a raw, realistic portrayal of war, showing suffering without romanticization
textos.aprecia uma fotografia bela e impactante: appreciate beautiful, impactful cinematography combined with an immersive technical atmosphere
textos.valoriza atuações marcantes e uma presen: value standout performances and an expressive presence from the lead
textos.aprecia uma boa adaptação do livro, mesm: appreciate a good adaptation of the book, even if it omits important aspects of the work
textos.procura uma narrativa emocionalmente pes: look for an emotionally heavy, sad and disturbing narrative with lasting impact
textos.rejeita adaptações que se afastam do tex: reject adaptations that depart from the original text and change established passages
textos.se cansa de narrativas longas e entedian: get tired of long, boring narratives that seem to stretch on unnecessarily
textos.se frustra com personagens sem profundid: get frustrated by characters without depth that make empathy with the plot difficult
textos.se incomoda com músicas dramáticas demai: are bothered by overly dramatic, insistent music that gets in the way of contemplation

textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Edward Be: Released in 2022 and directed by Edward Berger, All Quiet on the Western Front is a war drama centered on the journey of a young teenager drafted to the front line of the First World War. Throughout the narrative, the protagonist faces the harsh, violent daily reality in the trenches.
textos.A experiência do filme se apoia em uma a: The film's experience rests on a raw, detailed setting of war scenes, driven by a measured pace and the length of its sequences. The atmosphere is marked by sensory intensity and the depiction of the conflict's brutality.
textos.Os grupos analisados concordam sobre as: The groups analyzed agree on the fundamental characteristics of what the film presents, but diverge in their verdict on how the work functions. Among the vast majority of ratings (~88%), a large portion highlights the raw, realistic depiction of war and its impacts. In addition, many praise the cinematography and technical aspects, while a significant share stresses the work of the performances and the characters.
textos.Para quem se posiciona na faixa de uma f: Among those in a minimal fraction of ratings (~10%), a considerable number report difficulty connecting emotionally with the soldiers on screen. From that same perspective, some point to the slow pace and prolonged running time, although a portion acknowledge the value of the cinematography and technical elements.
textos.Já sob a ótica de quem atribui uma fraçã: From the standpoint of those who account for an even smaller fraction of ratings (~2%), a good portion criticize the departure from the book and from the earlier adaptation. For this group, several describe the experience as marked by a slow, drawn-out pace, while a portion of them judge the characters shallow and underdeveloped.
